#519 · Tiny Pigeon Pokémon

Pidove

Normal Flying

Unova · Generation 5

Pidove is a Normal/Flying-type Tiny Pigeon Pokémon first found in Unova (Generation 5). It stands 0.3 m tall and weighs 2.1 kg. It evolves into Tranquill. Its highest base stat is Attack (55), with a base stat total of 264.
